sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet identities reviewed against yesterday. 100 dated September 8–9 SubnetRadar briefs checked, with material developments separated from chat and older events.

Signed-in X Latest searches covered all 128 SN numbers and current names or aliases in 16 grouped queries. Additional searches covered Bittensor/TAO and partner accounts including OpenTensor, Forever Money, Chainlink, Sunrise, StonkFun, Buttensor and Cats. Grok was used for discovery and its links were checked against original sources.
92 public X account candidates checked; 90 returned post samples. 150 unique in-window post records were retrieved, with full original text checked for material stories.
Authenticated AlphaGap feed reviewed: 37 visible cards. TAO Daily, TAO Media and the public subnet feed were checked for additional leads.
153 mapped repository paths scanned with pagination, then refreshed through 11:13 AM ET. Selected commits and public documentation checked for actual changes and launch limitations.

Primary verification included Y Combinator’s ORO directory entry, BitMind’s zero-burn commit, qBitTensor’s restoration announcement, UMI’s bootstrap gates, Cortex’s current product status and dated project announcements.
Network prices and emission shares sampled at 11:13 AM ET and compared with yesterday’s saved snapshot. Price badges use rolling 24-hour α/TAO, not USD.

YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. New members upload bUPt2C9_irc verified at 18:35, September 8; membership access confirmed. RL Bryer remains scheduled for September 9 at 16:00 UTC. Latest public regular upload remains L3wLKIoYz1c, 22:44.

SubnetRadar Moments chain-event feed reviewed through the saved cutoff for lock reductions, new conviction, leadership rankings, coldkey swaps and subnet identity changes. Three detailed in-window events were retained with their block numbers and UTC publication timestamps; events already covered yesterday were not repeated.
accessGaps: X was sampled rather than exhaustively paginated. Grouped discovery queries excluded replies and ambiguous names produced unrelated matches; selected full threads and account samples supplemented them. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts may still be missing. X also returned intermittent 429 responses while loading profile metadata; visible search results remained readable.

Private Discord history was not accessed directly. AlphaGap and SubnetRadar summaries are discovery, not automatic proof of team authorship. ReadyAI’s buyback, MVTRX’s release, NOVA’s bounty details, NeverPlayAlone’s new mission and Sundae’s deadline remain developing where dated primary confirmation was not retrieved.

Five historical repository paths returned 404: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, Satori119/Satori, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME and Oh-My-Ditto/ditto. New SN119 documentation was checked separately. Cross-linked Lium and Refinery repositories were attributed to SN51 and SN125, not stale profile mappings.

The 19-slot emission comparison uses timestamped provider data, not an independent reconstruction of every chain event. A positive subnet share or a merged burn change does not demonstrate every miner was paid. DSperse still showed zero subnet emissions at the market cutoff.

Pareton’s linked external run page could not be retrieved independently. Bitsec’s post did not expose a public advisory or affected-version details. Performance, customer, reward-distribution and signup figures are attributed to their publishers where not independently reconciled.

UMI translation rewards remain inactive in its source; the bootstrap has separate cutover gates. CapabilityForge Next initially published a description and images, not a mining implementation. Cortex’s site explicitly says automatic payouts are not wired and Bounty scoring is paused. Refinery deployment was not independently established.

AlphaGap’s BitMind misconduct allegation and Cacheon takeover description were not corroborated and were excluded. Ditto’s first-party post still calls V2 preparation; broader launch claims were not treated as confirmation. Previously covered Chutes leadership, Hippius Drive pricing and original TAO-pair/bridge launches were not recycled as new events.

Dated briefs can span events before the exact cutoff; retained September 8 follow-ups add material context and retain their date. No verified forward alpha-unlock calendar was found. Research cutoff is 11:13 AM ET on September 9; later posts belong to the next edition.

Chain-event figures are attributed to SubnetRadar’s automatic records and were not independently reconstructed from archival chain state. Lock reductions do not prove token sales; a subnet-king ranking change does not alone confirm an ownership transfer. One Almanac perpetual-lock lead had no retrievable detail body and was excluded.

editorialDecisions.decision: Five-star lead confirmed in YC’s Fall 2026 directory and ORO’s post. No unsupported historical superlatives or undisclosed funding amount.

Nineteen slots had zero emissions yesterday and a positive share today. qBitTensor confirms SN48 and SN63. All comparison values are retained here. No claim of one common cause or complete miner payouts.
Version 5.0.3 removes the 80% baseline burn; the source allocation is 40/40/4/16. Current subnet emissions are positive. The unsupported AlphaGap misconduct allegation was excluded.
IM means incentive mechanism. Leadpoet says integrations are built, user engagement through them is coming soon and the mechanism targets this week. Customer claims are attributed to Leadpoet.
New identity and description confirmed. The initial repository contains a README and images. No implemented mining network or new owner identity is claimed.

A congressional-office meeting is not government endorsement. The single-example 71% semantic match is not general accuracy. The equal-service bootstrap is separate from translation ranking and needs a finalized chain cutover.

The fee correction describes the September 3 simulation-fee change and an incorrect real-hardware fee. Values are historical, with miners directed to the live competition API. The Joó meeting is not a contract.
The primary site describes partial judging, in-memory submissions, unsealed weights, unwired automatic payouts and paused Bounty scoring. New source execution is not proof of full activation.
Ditto’s first-party post says V2 is in preparation; secondary launch claims were not treated as confirmation.
Verathos adds receiving-team confirmation after yesterday’s MicroTensor announcement. The deployment is explicitly on testnet.
The continuing large price decline and positive emissions are both reported. No unverified cause or misconduct is asserted.
Stonk’s $21 million reward milestone is platform-wide. BUTT payouts are not unique holders, and the 3% tax is not yield. The CONST community post is not an announcement by Bittensor’s founder.

The September 8 members video is 1,115 seconds and membership-gated. The September 6 video remains in the library. The accessible public default is retained. The stream is scheduled for 16:00 UTC and is not labeled live.
Large conviction lock and separate reduction combined into one four-star update. Neither token sales nor wallet motives inferred.
Subnet-king ranking change reported separately from Pareton’s inference benchmark. No completed ownership transfer claimed.
